text_block_list.text:
Finally, it's time for the autumn Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The stadium is packed with fans eager to
witness
Сайленс Судзука's prowess on the
racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unlike the effervescent mood in the
stands, the
atmosphere in the prep room
is heavy and
somber.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука reveals that her leg has
been
hurting. Despite this, she is
confident in herself
and pleads for
permission to stay in the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The logical thing would be to consider
her future
and withdraw her from the
race, but I trust her
when she says she
can run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
